description: Update an existing product. Pass only the fields to change. Use this to adjust price, rename, or republish a product without losing its productId — changing the id would break checkout flows already wired into the app.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code Stripe charges in, e.g. "usd"; the price is checked again in it

interval.description: subscription: how often it renews (new subscribers)

name.description: Product name, string or { en: "...", es: "..." }

price.description: Price in cents (one_time; per period for subscription — applies to new subscribers)

productId.description: The product ID returned by neblla_create_product

published.description: Whether the product is buyable (without an active payout account it waits, as in neblla_create_product)

name: neblla_update_product
